Test case: Manual publish creates the PDF in Assets
Steps:
1. Open the map in AEM Guides (Map console) > Output tab > select the PDF preset for the brand (BenQ With Image / BenQ EDU With Image / Zowie / INFTY).
2. Click Generate.
3. Wait until the output shows Finished.
4. Go to Assets > Files > /content/dam/fmdita-outputs (PDF) - the map's properties also record the latest PDF path.
Expected result: A new PDF file for this map exists in Assets. Its created date/time is after the Generate click. It opens and is not 0 KB.

Test case: Manual publish replaces/adds the file on a second run
Steps:
1. Note the PDF's created/modified time in Assets.
2. Generate the same preset again.
3. Check the asset again.
Expected result: The asset is updated (newer modified time) or a new version is added. No duplicate or broken file is left behind.
To confirm: Confirm expected behaviour: overwrite or new file

Test case: Manual publish creates the AEM Sites pages
Steps:
1. Open the map in AEM Guides (Map console) > Output tab > select the AEM Sites preset.
2. Click Generate.
3. Wait until Finished.
4. Go to Sites > /content/guide/<lang>/... for this product.
Expected result: The site pages for the map are created/updated under /content/guide. Page names have no -0 / -1 suffix. The page opens.

Test case: PDF and AEM Sites selected together
Steps:
1. Open the map in AEM Guides (Map console) > Output tab.
2. Tick BOTH the PDF preset and the AEM Sites preset.
3. Generate.
4. Check Assets (PDF) and Sites (pages).
Expected result: Both outputs are created: the PDF file in Assets and the pages in Sites.

Test case: Auto publish creates the PDF in Assets
Preconditions: Auto publish is enabled for the product/map
Steps:
1. Do the action that triggers auto publish (e.g. approve / save the topic or map).
2. Do NOT click Generate.
3. Wait.
4. Go to Assets > Files > /content/dam/fmdita-outputs (PDF) - the map's properties also record the latest PDF path.
Expected result: A new PDF for the map is created in Assets without a manual Generate. Created time is after the trigger.

Test case: Auto publish creates/updates the AEM Sites pages
Steps:
1. Trigger auto publish.
2. Go to Sites > /content/guide/<lang>/... for this product.
Expected result: Site pages are created/updated without a manual Generate.
To confirm: Confirm whether auto publish covers Sites, PDF or both

Test case: No auto publish when the trigger does not happen
Steps:
1. Edit a topic but do not complete the trigger action.
2. Check Assets and Sites.
Expected result: No new PDF and no page update are created.

Test case: Generated file is in the right place with the right name
Steps:
1. Go to Assets > Files > /content/dam/fmdita-outputs (PDF) - the map's properties also record the latest PDF path.
2. Open the file's Properties.
Expected result: File name matches the map/product. Properties show the source map path. The file is a valid PDF with the expected page count (> 0).

Test case: Failed publish does not leave a file
Preconditions: A map with a broken reference (or cancel the generation)
Steps:
1. Generate.
2. Wait for Failed.
3. Check Assets.
Expected result: No new/partial file is created. The map console shows the failure.

Test case: Publish 5 language maps - all 5 files created
Preconditions: Translated maps exist for 5 languages (e.g. en, de, fr, es, ar)
Steps:
1. For each of the 5 language maps: Open the map in AEM Guides (Map console) > Output tab > select the preset > Generate (trigger all 5 one after another).
2. Wait until all 5 are Finished.
3. Go to Assets.
Expected result: 5 files exist in Assets, one per language. Each is created after its trigger. None is missing or 0 KB.

Test case: Each language file holds that language's content
Steps: 1. Open each of the 5 files.
Expected result: Each PDF is in its own language (not English text in the German file, etc.). Titles/TOC are translated.

Test case: One language fails, the others still publish
Preconditions: 5 language maps, one with a broken reference
Steps:
1. Trigger all 5.
2. Wait.
3. Check Assets.
Expected result: The 4 good languages create their files. The failed one creates none and is reported as failed.
To confirm: Confirm how a failure is shown in the email

Test case: Single publish sends one email
Preconditions: Publisher's email is set in AEM; mailbox reachable
Steps:
1. Publish one map.
2. Check the mailbox.
Expected result: One email is received. It names the file/map that was published and its link/path.

Test case: 5 publishes -> ONE email listing all 5 files
Steps:
1. Trigger all 5 publishes.
2. Wait until all 5 are finished.
3. Check the mailbox.
Expected result: Exactly ONE email is received (not 5). It lists all 5 files. Each entry matches a file that exists in Assets.

Test case: Email is sent only after ALL triggered publishes finish
Steps:
1. Trigger all 5.
2. Check the mailbox while only some are finished.
3. Check again after the last one finishes.
Expected result: No email while publishes are still running. The single email arrives after the 5th finishes.

Test case: List in the email is complete and correct
Steps: 1. Compare the list in the email with the files in Assets.
Expected result: Same count (5 of 5), same names/languages, no duplicates, no file from an earlier run.

Test case: Auto publish also sends the email
Steps:
1. Trigger auto publish for several maps.
2. Check the mailbox.
Expected result: One email with all auto-published files, same format as manual publish.

Test case: Email when one of the 5 fails
Steps:
1. Trigger all 5.
2. Check the email.
Expected result: One email. The 4 successful files are listed; the failed one is shown as failed (or left out) as designed.

Test case: Arabic PDF: Arabic template selected in the properties
Steps:
1. Open the Arabic map's PROPERTIES and select the Arabic template.
2. Open the map in AEM Guides (Map console) > Output tab > select the PDF preset '<brand preset> Arabic' (e.g. BenQ With Image Arabic).
3. Generate.
4. Check Assets.
Expected result: The PDF is created in Assets. Text is right-to-left, Arabic font, tables and lists mirrored.
To confirm: Confirm the exact property field name where the Arabic template is selected

Test case: Arabic AEM Sites: Arabic template selected in the properties
Steps:
1. Open the Arabic map's PROPERTIES and select the Arabic template.
2. Open the map in AEM Guides (Map console) > Output tab > select the AEM Sites preset.
3. Generate.
4. Go to Sites > /content/guide/ar-.../
Expected result: Site pages are created with the Arabic (right-to-left) template.
To confirm: Confirm whether Sites uses the same property or a separate Sites template field

Test case: Arabic WITHOUT the Arabic template (negative)
Preconditions: Arabic map, default (non-Arabic) template left in the properties
Steps:
1. Do not select the Arabic template.
2. Generate PDF and AEM Sites.
Expected result: Output is wrong (left-to-right layout) - this shows the template selection is required. Record the result.

Test case: Arabic included in a multi-language publish
Preconditions: 5 languages including Arabic; Arabic template selected in the Arabic map's properties
Steps:
1. Trigger all 5.
2. Check Assets and the email.
Expected result: Arabic file is created with the Arabic template; the other 4 use the normal template. The one email lists all 5 including Arabic.
